# 117.1 — PR explainer (HIGH tier): pool-detail rate-stability Sharpe annotation

**Item:** Surface leg 1 of 117 — pool-detail Sharpe annotation.
**Spec:** `specs/117.1.md` (+ `specs/117.md`). **Notes:** `specs/117.1-notes.md`. **Risk:** HIGH
(user-facing render-path change presenting a new trust-rail-derived number, EN+KO).
**Ship:** one commit / one PR on the harness-pinned branch, self-merged after verifier PASS + tests green.

## Goal
Show the cautious-saver, on pool detail, the rate-stability Sharpe that item 117 already computes
(`pool.kpis.apySharpe`) — the quantified form of 088's "steady 6% beats spiky 20%" — with the
honest principal-risk caveat, so the SEO arrival surface carries one more trustworthy, one-sentence
signal. No new number is computed here; 117 already bakes `apySharpe` into the daily snapshot. This
is purely the first display surface (117's spec mandates surfaces ship "one at a time, pool-detail
first").

## Intuition
`PoolDetail.js` already has a calm neuro "rate-track-record" note (item 088.1) that surfaces
`kpis.historyPoints` + `kpis.apyStdev`. `apySharpe` lives in the same `kpis` object. So the whole
change is: add **one more line to that existing note**, guarded so it only appears when
`apySharpe` is a real number (it's `null` until a pool has ≥8 daily history points), naming the
~4% risk-free benchmark and stating plainly that this is about yield steadiness, **not** principal
safety.

## What changed, in reading order

### `PoolDetail.js` (~L1357)
Inside the existing `rate-track-record-note` `<div>`, immediately after the stdev IIFE, a second
child was added:
```js
(typeof pool.kpis.apySharpe === 'number') && React.createElement('div', { style: { marginTop: '6px' } },
  t ? t('rateSharpeNote', _formatNum(pool.kpis.apySharpe))
    : `Rate-stability score ${_formatNum(pool.kpis.apySharpe)} (vs a ~4% risk-free rate): how steady this pool's yield has been relative to how much it pays — not a measure of principal safety.`
)
```
- The parent block already guards `pool.kpis` being an object with `historyPoints >= 1`, so the
  property access is safe. When `apySharpe` is `null`/absent the guard is falsy → nothing renders
  (graceful null-hide, matching the block's own discipline).
- `_formatNum` (en-US) formats the dimensionless ratio — NOT `_formatApy`, because a Sharpe is not
  a percentage.
- `marginTop:'6px'` inline only — ZERO new CSS. The line inherits the parent note's neuro surface,
  color, and font.
- The block's guard, styles, and the existing stdev IIFE are byte-untouched.

### `translations.js`
New `rateSharpeNote(s)` key in BOTH the EN block (~L50) and the KO block (~L729). Each names the
~4% risk-free benchmark and carries the principal-safety caveat; the KO is a natural translation,
not a gloss. EN-only would be a FAIL.

### Regenerated artifacts
`node compile-app.js` + `node minify-assets.js` regenerated `PoolDetail.compiled.js`,
`PoolDetail.compiled.min.js`, and `translations.min.js` (prod loads compiled+min). `app.compiled.*`
is unchanged because `app.js` was not edited — correct and expected. A second regen run reproduced
the identical diff (deterministic/idempotent).

### `package.json`
`node test_kpi_sharpe_annotation.js` added to the `test` chain after `test_kpi_tvl_trend.js`.

### `test_kpi_sharpe_annotation.js` (new)
Rendered-Playwright, house harness (vendored React/Babel, DefiLlama-shaped fixture, external hosts
routed per the sandbox pattern): S1 finite apySharpe → annotation with "4%" + caveat, no raw key;
S2 apySharpe:null → parent note renders but annotation absent; S3 `?lang=ko` → Korean copy present;
S4 zero page errors.

## Deviation from spec
None material. The spec said "one additional line next to the stdev note"; implemented as an
additional child `<div>` directly under the stdev sentence inside the same note (visually one line
beneath it), which is the natural realization in this createElement block.

## Trust rails / NEVER-list
Byte-untouched. Reads a derived `kpis.apySharpe` and renders it with a mandated caveat; never
weakens `APY_SANITY_LIMIT`/`DEFAULT_MIN_TVL`/anomaly flags/degen haircut, never touches the
`__APP_MODE` router or `?token=`/`?chain=`/`?pool=` behavior (grep-confirmed). Renders only inside
the existing block, which runs only on a rendered, rail-passing detail pool. Not on the NEVER list
→ auto-mergeable after verifier PASS.
